headline: 3 Major Reasons to Buy Vertiv Before July 29 Q2 Earnings
summary: Vertiv enters its July 29 earnings report with a $15 billion backlog and a stock price sitting well below analyst targets, but one regional blind spot could complicate the bull case entirely.
